description: Every used Tesla TeslaTracker lists, in a local store that answers questions the site cannot — price paths, cohort placement, warranty left, and what already left the lot.

tools.name: inventory_get
tools.description: Fetch the full TeslaTracker detail record for one used Tesla by VIN. Required: vin (17-character VIN, in the path). Returns model, trim, year, condition, mileage, rated range, acceleration, top speed, drive type, hardware version, FSD flag, wheels, exterior/interior color, locationCity and locationState with latitude/longitude, purchasePrice and transportFee (both in cents), the four warranty fields (battery and vehicle expiry date plus their mileage limits), teslaUrl, and vehiclePhotos. Use this when rated spec, location, and warranty are enough; prefer inventory_report when you also need measured range, availability, or listing age.

tools.name: inventory_list
tools.description: List the used-Tesla inventory index one page at a time. Optional: page (integer, roughly 23 listings per page; omit for the first page). This endpoint serves HTML, so the tool returns link records — name, text, image, url, slug — one per listing, not full vehicle records. Use it to enumerate the VINs currently listed, then call inventory_get or inventory_report per VIN for specs, pricing, and warranty data.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number; roughly 23 listings per page

tools.name: inventory_report
tools.description: Fetch the vehicle history report for one used Tesla by VIN — a superset of inventory_get. Required: vin (17-character VIN, in the path). On top of the detail fields it adds optionCodeList, factoryCode, factoryGatedDate, actualRange (measured, as opposed to the rated range field), category, currentPrice, totalPrice, discount, leaseMonthly and financing detail (term, interest rate, monthly payment, cash down), autopilot options, isAvailable, and firstSeenAt/lastSeenAt. All money fields are in cents. Prefer this over inventory_get whenever the question involves real range, whether the car is still available, or how long it has been listed.
